scope: All current modified/new deliverable files plus explicit direct dependencies reviewed by root and three delegated reviewers
limits: The entire inherited repository was not deeply audited. Unchanged files outside the explicit scope remain unreviewed; no current behavioral claim is made for them.
B entries include generated schema/catalogue/projection/lock files, binary screenshots and machine evidence; hashing or running tests does not establish source-level understanding.
No sampled C entries. A entries are only assigned when a current complete reading is recorded; changed stale A entries downgrade to B until reread.
hashBinding: Candidate source bytes. After clean commit, final repository binding is recorded outside the git tree in BMS-acceptance.
